app.name: Trippy
app.one_liner: A modern, cross-platform network diagnostic tool with a terminal-based UI for advanced traceroute analysis.

screens.name: Main Traceroute View
screens.purpose: Display live traceroute results with hop details, round-trip times, and optional DSCP/ECN columns.

rust_commands.name: load_config
rust_commands.purpose: Load configuration from XDG app config directory or provided file path using TOML format.

rust_commands.name: start_traceroute
rust_commands.purpose: Initiate a new traceroute session with specified target, address family, ToS, and DNS resolution method.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add support for IPv4/IPv6 address families
week 1: Implement core packet probing logic using raw sockets
week 1: Integrate TOML config loading from XDG directory
week 1: Render basic TUI with Ratatui showing hop table
acceptance_tests: Given a target host, Trippy displays live hop-by-hop latency in the TUI within 2 seconds.
The application runs without panic when --first-ttl > 1 (regression test from 0.12.2).
Trippy loads configuration from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/trippy/config.toml if present.
When --tos is set, DSCP and ECN columns appear and reflect configured values.
